verdict.rationale: Workspace export is a fair question for a project-management tool like Trello, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of any export capability, let alone one that keeps comments, attachments and audit trails. The only data-portability item is about importing into Trello, which is a different feature, and the REST API listing is a developer building block, not an export feature.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know that exporting my workspace preserves full history—comments, attachments, and audit trails—not just task titles
